tokens.name: floor
tokens.usage: Window ground. Shows only where the backdrop has not loaded, and behind the details sheet. Never a panel color.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: Bottom fade over the backdrop on the Garage home so the launch bar reads. Secondary views add shade-dim on top.

tokens.name: shade-dim
tokens.usage: Flat dim laid over the whole backdrop on every view except the Garage home, so dense glass panels stay readable.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Light glass: nav pill, profile pill, messages panel, toasts, stat chips on the Garage home. Always with glass-blur and glass-edge.

tokens.name: glass-dense
tokens.usage: Dense glass for lists and forms (Servers, Host, Settings, Mods). Use when a panel holds more than one line of body text per row.

tokens.name: glass-solid
tokens.usage: Fallback fill for any glass surface when backdrop-filter is unavailable or reduced transparency is on.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border on text fields only. Glass panels and pills have no border.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: 1px inner top highlight on glass (part of the glass shadow).

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for nav pills and pill buttons on glass.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for list rows and message rows inside glass.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Fill of the selected server row or mod row, with selected-edge as an inset 1px ring.

tokens.name: selected-edge
tokens.usage: Inset 1px ring on the selected row.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Text field fill, stat tile fill and the off-state switch track inside glass.

tokens.name: log
tokens.usage: The server log panel. Deliberately not glass: a log is read, not navigated.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on glass, on the shaded backdrop and on floor. Also the fill of the current nav pill, solid buttons and the switch knob ground.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on glass and on the shaded backdrop: launch-bar state line, previews, captions.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Uppercase field labels and column headers on glass-dense. Not for running text on light glass over bright art.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled button labels and the off-state switch knob. Never for information the player needs.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink fills, on play, and on every event color fill.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The orange of the Afterhours mark's second bar. The logo only; never a button, status or tag.

tokens.name: play
tokens.usage: The primary action only: Play, Connect, Next in setup, the unread count. One per screen. The blue of the game's own logo. Text on it is on-ink.

tokens.name: speed
tokens.usage: Event type Speed (sprints, races, invites to race). Also the info status dot (In game).

tokens.name: style
tokens.usage: Event type Style (drift, tandem, photo meets).

tokens.name: build
tokens.usage: Event type Build (garage, stock cups, tuning). Also the warning status: verifying, mismatch, offline.

tokens.name: crew
tokens.usage: Event type Crew (meets, free roam). Also the online and ready status, the online avatar ring and the on-state switch.

tokens.name: outlaw
tokens.usage: Event type Outlaw (cops on, pursuits). Also mods: the Mods nav dot and mod downloads.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Sixth avatar color. Avatars only; never a status or tag.

tokens.name: status-ready
tokens.usage: Ready, online, running. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Verifying, mismatch, offline, server full. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: In game, joined. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-mods
tokens.usage: Downloading mods, modded server. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of an inline warning note, with warn-edge as its border and warn-ink as its text.

tokens.name: warn-edge
tokens.usage: Border of an inline warning note.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text of an inline warning note on warn-soft over glass.

tokens.name: mods-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the Preview badge on Mods; mods-ink text.

tokens.name: mods-ink
tokens.usage: Text on mods-soft.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The Garage home clock only. Tabular numerals, on the shaded backdrop with text-on-art.

styles.name: car-name
styles.usage: Launch-bar left value: the car, server or setup step. Uppercase, directly on the floor.

styles.name: view-title
styles.usage: The title inside a view's main glass panel. Uppercase.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Section heading inside a glass panel, next to its 30px icon tile. Uppercase.

styles.name: play
styles.usage: The play button label. Uppercase. Drops to 20px for longer busy labels (Verifying 62%).

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Nav pills. 800 on the current pill. Uppercase.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Pill buttons and filters. 700 on outline and text buttons. Uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, column headers, eyebrow labels (12px, 0.16em on the floor). Uppercase.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Event-type tags and small chips. Uppercase, on-ink on the tag color.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Crew meets every evening. Sprint at 21:00, stock tunes only.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names: servers, drivers, mods, list-row titles.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Friends on the same network can find and join.
styles.usage: Hints under controls and the launch-bar state line.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Addresses, ping, builds, paths, timestamps, counts. Never uppercase by CSS.

styles.name: data-small
styles.usage: Secondary data: profile subline, message times, file sizes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside pill groups (nav pill padding, gap between pills).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, avatars-to-text, buttons in a pair.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows of a form, panel inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on small panels, gap between glass panels in a grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between the main panel and the side panel; main area top padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Window side gutter. Every view keeps 24px from the window edge.

tokens.name: header-top
tokens.usage: Space above the header row.

tokens.name: launchbar-bottom
tokens.usage: Space under the launch bar to the window edge.

tokens.name: radius-thumb
tokens.usage: Server art thumbnails in rows and message avatars for servers.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Text fields and icon tiles (30px tiles use 10px).

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Selectable rows, stat tiles and inline notes inside glass.

tokens.name: radius-play
tokens.usage: The play button and its disabled and progress states.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Toasts and invite cards.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Main glass panels (Servers list, Host, Settings sections use 24px).

tokens.name: radius-phone
tokens.usage: The side panel (messages, server details, mod details) and the first-run card (30px).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Nav, profile pill, pill buttons, filters, chips, tags, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every glass surface.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The first-run card, which floats alone in the middle.

tokens.name: shadow-avatar
tokens.usage: Gap ring between stacked avatars.

blur.note: Glass blur. Always with saturate(1.4) so the garage light stays warm through the glass.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Default backdrop blur for every glass surface.

tokens.name: glass-blur-heavy
tokens.usage: The first-run card and the server switcher, which sit over the brightest part of the art.

size.note: Fixed control sizes. Every target the player clicks is at least 38px tall inside a 44px hit area.

tokens.name: play-height
tokens.usage: Play button height.

tokens.name: play-min-width
tokens.usage: Play button minimum width, so the label never reflows between states.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Nav pills, pill buttons, filters.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Text fields.

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Stacked avatars in rows.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Profile pill and driver lists.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Avatar picker and toasts.

tokens.name: window-min-width
tokens.usage: Smallest launcher window the layout is designed for; below it panels stack.
